source:
Install into
the aperture, retain 3.2 and 1.5 mm, -10 °C, 60% and 120/120/120 with all qualifiers.
display: Install to aperture, retain 3.2 and 1.5 mm, -10 °C, 60% and 120/120/120 w/ all qualifiers.

source: FIREFLY Penowrap, FIREFLYPenowrap, PENOWRAP® and Penowrap™; TWrap and Intubatt are distinct.
display: wrap, wrap, wrap and wrap; TWrap and Intubatt are distinct.

source: In order to seal the aperture, install a minimum of 2 layers using Mastic in accordance with Section 4.6. Maximum 50 mm; approximately 3.2 mm including joints.
display: to seal aperture, install min. 2 layers w/ Mastic p/ Section 4.6. max. 50 mm; approx. 3.2 mm incl. joints.

source: The board is required to be at least 50 mm thick on both sides of the wall; no more than 2 layers, unless otherwise stated.
display: board must be min. 50 mm thick on both wall faces; no more than 2 layers, unless otherwise stated.

source: The Batt layers are glued together using Mastic. All cut edges, including layer joints and the wall perimeter interface, to be coated with Brush Grade.
display: Glue Batt layers together w/ Mastic. Coat all cut edges, incl. layer joints and wall perimeter interface w/ BG.

source: Only for tested walls; not interchangeable or generally approved. Nominal 50 mm, except where stated otherwise. Either 2 or 3 layers; may be used if permitted.
display: Only for tested walls; not interchangeable or generally approved. Nominal 50 mm, except where stated otherwise. Either 2 or 3 layers; may be used if permitted.

source: A minimum of 2 layers prior to installation; a maximum of 3 layers subsequent to installation. The seal is required for -/120/120; at most 60% compression.
display: min. 2 layers before installation; max. 3 layers after installation. seal required for -/120/120; max. 60% compression.

source: One layer on each side of the wall, recessed 50 mm from the face of the wall, provided that support achieves required FRL.
display: One layer on each wall face, recessed 50 mm from wall face, provided support achieves required FRL.

source: Source configuration ratings remain subject to the stated barrier construction and installation conditions. The entry selection remains separate; no missing values have been inferred.
display: Source ratings subject to stated barrier construction and installation conditions. Entry selection remains separate; no missing values inferred.

source: Install in between layers to ensure that all gaps are sealed, at a distance of 50 mm. In the event that 2 layers are used, provided that approval applies, fit using steel ties for the purpose of securing wrap in addition to fixings.
display: Install between layers to ensure all gaps are sealed, at 50 mm. if 2 layers are used, provided approval applies, fit w/ steel ties for securing wrap plus fixings.

source: When using Batt, coat edges. The seals are required to be at least 25 mm deep; seals are required for -/120/120.
display: When using Batt, coat edges. seals must be min. 25 mm deep; seals required for -/120/120.
